localMonorepo.layoutAssumption: The DevPod CLI stays at the repository root. Each satellite occupies a directory named after its GitHub repository. devpod-demo lives at examples/devpod-demo. A local checkout at 71f0995c was not readable from this environment; these prefixes are the reconciliation contract.
